svg.title: One conversation's tokens and pages
svg.text: Engine::Conversation: Mei's tokens, what is cached (kv.length) and kv.pages
kv.pages 0–19: the lore every NPC's prompt starts with, shared through the prefix cache
after Send(): the new turn (amber) is appended, not cached (outlined)
after the next Step(): the turn is cached; Accept appended the first reply token
<|im_end|> \n that Finish wrote after the reply
full page: published to the prefix cache
Send: record where the turn starts, append it; the reply's prompt is everything uncached
SampleNext: the step's tokens are cached now
Publish: offer the pages that just filled up to the prefix cache
Finish: append <|im_end|> and \n, cached with the next turn
